annotation.title_en: Government of Canada AI Register (Minimum Viable Product)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of Canada (Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat), Open Government Portal
annotation.summary_en: Bilingual change log for the Government of Canada's AI Register (Minimum Viable Product), a public inventory of federal AI systems. It records the initial publication on 2025-11-28 and an update on 2026-04-28 that removed duplicate entries and added AI systems. The excerpt contains no register content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Initial publication of the GC AI Register (MVP) on 2025-11-28
Update on 2026-04-28 removed duplicate entries and added AI systems
Affected entries include 25-26-ESDCEDSC-016 and 25-26-PS-SP001 to SP004
Bilingual English/French publication on the Open Government Portal
